notes: A single AI monster hunting players through a scary forest is Survival, and the prompt's own framing as a hide-and-seek game earns Party & Casual as a second genre without letting it take the shape. Mascot Horror is the preset whose mode this is - an AI hunter you hide from - but its interior-single shape is replaced by space-bounded, because the answers describe a compact 3D forest a few hundred studs across, which is the contained arena keeping the threat and the players in proximity; Liminal Horror matches the option triple more neatly and was rejected because its whole point is an unbounded endless interior. gate-escape was dropped since the round is won by defeating the monster with the scattered items rather than by reaching an exit, and collectible-nodes is what places those items. Decided without a user: the 1000/200 health split and the single-monster choice are combat balance, so the layout job is hiding cover, the monster's entry and patrol ground, and the item distribution that makes fighting back possible.
